shortDescription: Manage Tree Quotas and User Quotas on PowerStore

options.name: array_ip
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerStore management system.

options.name: description
options.description: Additional information that can be mentioned for a Tree Quota. Description parameter can only be used when I(quota_type) is C(tree).

options.name: filesystem
options.description: The ID/Name of the filesystem for which the Tree/User Quota  will be created. If filesystem name is specified, then I(nas_server) is required to uniquely identify the filesystem.

options.name: nas_server
options.description: The NAS server. This could be the name or ID of the NAS server.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerStore host.

options.name: path
options.description: The path on which the quota will be imposed. Path is relative to the root of the filesystem. For user quota, if I(path) is not specified, quota will be created at the root of the filesystem.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number for the PowerStore array. If not passed, it will take 443 as default.

options.name: quota_id
options.description: Id of the user/tree quota. If I(quota_id) is mentioned, then I(path)/I(nas_server)/I(file_system)/I(quota_type) is not required.

options.name: quota_type
options.description: The type of quota which will be imposed.

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the Quota should exist or not. Value C(present)  indicates that the Quota should exist on the system. Value C(absent)  indicates that the Quota should not exist on the system.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: uid
options.description: The ID of the unix user account for which quota operations will be performed. Any one among C(uid)/C(unix_name)/C(windows_name)/C(windows_sid) is required when I(quota_type) is C(user).

options.name: unix_name
options.description: The name of the unix user account for which quota operations will be performed. Any one among C(uid)/C(unix_name)/C(windows_name)/C(windows_sid) is required when I(quota_type) is C(user).

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the PowerStore host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. Set the environment variable REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE to the path of the SSL certificate. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.

options.name: windows_name
options.description: The name of the Windows User for which quota operations will be performed. The name should be mentioned along with Domain Name as 'DOMAIN_NAME\user_name' or as "DOMAIN_NAME\\user_name". Any one among C(uid)/C(unix_name)/C(windows_name)/C(windows_sid) is required when I(quota_type) is C(user).

options.name: windows_sid
options.description: The SID of the Windows User account for which quota operations will be performed. Any one among C(uid)/C(unix_name)/C(windows_name)/C(windows_sid) is required when I(quota_type) is C(user).
